Iffland became the first person to win four world championship high diving titles at the 2024 World Aquatics Championships in Doha, Qatar.

result.title: Rhiannan Iffland - Wikipedia
result.content: Rhiannan Iffland (born 9 September 1991) is an Australian high diver. She is a ten-time consecutive Red Bull Cliff Diving World Series champion (2016- 2019, 2021-2026). [1][2] She won her first championship in 2016 as a wildcard entrant in her debut year, the first-ever rookie to do so. [3][4]
